items: No indicator trading
TP & SL fixed 1:2 RR
Lot size fixed 0.02
No trade in London session
Always confirm with red / green candle
No trade in ranging market
No FOMO
No multiple trades in same direction
Full TP
No scalping
No non-session entry
Confirmational biased
No revenge trading
Safe TP always
3–4 trades per day max
Wait after setup forms
If rejection, then wait
5m healthy candle, then entry
After 4 SL, stop trading
No anger on market
Follow the indicator in the direction of the bias.
After 1:1.5 RR, move SL to cost-to-cost (breakeven). If the breakeven SL is hit, you can plan again if the bias still gives LTF confirmation.
In trading, not a single mistake is forgiven — the market punishes.
Safe TP and SL are very important.
Don't trust the black gold indicator — take extra confirmation from it like a confirmation. Follow the indicator with the bias only.
Follow timing: trade in sessions only.

CTC (breakeven) is the best option — at least you won't take a loss. If in doubt, move to CTC. If price reaches 1:1 RR, move to CTC. If CTC is hit after that, you can plan again if the setup forms again.
Don't trade with ego or anger.
Trade only after the pattern has fully formed — e.g. if a 5m FVG is about to form, don't enter after only two candles.
Don't trade with a hoping mindset.
Don't plan a trade that can end in a big loss.
No trading in the office.
No gambling.
No loss recovery — trade only your setup and follow the process.
No hopping trading — don't jump from pair to pair or from setup to setup.
Don't increase your lot size after continuous SLs.
Don't take multiple trades at once in the same direction — wait until the first trade is at CTC.
NFP news is very powerful.
Structure → TF → liquidity are fractal → POI also.
The market spends 70% of its time in accumulation → waiting time.
In expansion and displacement, the move will be very smooth and the pullback very small — it keeps going up/down.
Don't assume a pattern in the market — after it forms, confirm it. Don't assume an FVG will form in two candles; let it form completely.
Keep in mind inflation / news and the report / data.
When there is no news, the Asian session gives a good move.
Where a 15m POI's retest does not happen, a big rally happens there.
In 3 candles, the 4th candle is expansion.
When news gives both +ve and –ve, price stays in a range — but NFP news is powerful. A single candle also forms.
In the market, if there is no news, the market moves according to structure and liquidity.
If structure is not clear in the market, wait for structure to form.
Mark premium and discount zones for major swings.
Many times, when there are no orders in the market, liquidity gets created and then hunted.
PDL/PDH work in a ranging market.
MB/BB are very powerful when price can't do the last POI.
When Monday comes, see what happened last week. If needed, look at the last 2 weeks too, and also look at the news in Forex Factory.
When price stays bullish for 2–3 months, in the third or fourth month it comes down to do (mitigate) the last POI.
Before news, the market goes quiet and tries to trap.
When a candle opens, mark the opening part of the daily candle.
OB + FVG are one-time use only → only unmitigated OF will work.
Mark the daily candle's open, high and low.
Every time in gold, after a bull run, price goes into a range.
If there are POIs on both sides, then give priority to the overall bias.
Retracement is the waiting phase.
Check the news before opening the chart and analyse the news of the past one week.
Do fundamental analysis.
Understand what is happening now and what is going to happen next.
Look at both the overall view and the current view.
The HTF and LTF views should be the same.
Read the chart and the situation.
Whenever you take a trade, you should be sure about it.
If you are taking 1m FVG confirmation, enter only after the FVG forms and the green/red candle closes.
Keep a safe target — don't be greedy. E.g. if MB/BB and OB are done, take TP at the MB and exit; the same for OB and FVG — take TP at the FVG and exit.
If there is a gap up / gap down, TP is the gap (fill), or below/above the swing.
At a 5m POI (5m zone), look for a 1m FVG — there should be 1–2 FVGs.
At a 15m zone, look for a 5m FVG.
At a 4H POI, look for a 15m (or at most 30m) FVG.
For targets, use MB/BB or swings as the safe target. If there is an MB/BB, keep it as the safe target.
At 4H/daily POIs, look for a 15m FVG. At a 1H zone, look for a 5m FVG. At a 15m zone, look for a 5m/3m FVG.
POI timeframe → confirmation timeframe: 15m → 5m · 5m → 1m/3m · 3m → 1m · 1m → green/red candle + healthy candle (buy). Sell: 1H → 15m/5m · 4H → 15m · Daily → 30m/1h.
At an all-time high, the target can be the nearest round number, or you can apply a swing projection.
Monthly and weekly → 1H confirmation.
You can refine down to the 5m. If a 1m FVG forms at the 30m zone, enter after one green 1m candle for buys (vice versa for sells), then trail the SL.
If the first POI feels risky, plan the trade at the second POI after it forms, on the 1m.
If in doubt, take double confirmation from the 1m POI.
If the POI is right, you can enter after a 5m FVG forms — whether or not the 5m POI is tapped (retested). Note: OB + FVG = POI.
You can take TP at the overlapping part.
You can trail the SL from OB to OB.
Suppose a candle's wick is forming and another candle closes its body there — that gives confirmation in the price's favour.
If you miss the entry, then when an FVG forms on the 5m at the 30m, enter after it forms, and keep the SL below/above the 30m. Don't wait for the retest.
If you enter from the ITH/ITL, keep the SL at the ITL/ITH as well.
Also keep the TP at the overlapping part, and at a HIPPO.
Keep the SL in the proper place — decide it in advance.
Keep the SL small. And take a big target.
Pairs I trade: XAUUSD, EURUSD and BTC only.
Following risk management is enough — follow it, and don't trade on the LTF.
In trading, keep control over yourself.
The main thing in trading is discipline.
Profit comes only from holding the right trade.
I don't look at the market — I look at the system.
You can't capture every entry and every move.
If you set the TP with logic, you won't have to regret it.
Don't decide in advance to take 1:5 RR — accept what the market is giving. Set the TP as a safe TP according to the structure.
If you are in a trade, focus on it completely — don't take another trade.
Make two accounts: one for swing trading and the other for intraday trading.
The fear of the profit running away
The whole problem in trading is mindset: fear of losing profit, and fear of the trade running away while you wait for the entry. Accept these and maintain risk management.
Intraday trades: at least 2–3 trades a week are fine
Every night, predict the next day's candle
You should not judge whether a trade was good or bad only by looking at whether it hit Take Profit (TP) or Stop Loss (SL).
You should judge the trade based on whether you followed your trading strategy correctly
A missed trade is better than a losing trade.
After news, take the trade with the bias and confirmation.
If price is reaching 1:2 RR, don't force it. Book according to the TP.
In trading: wait (90%) → patience; trade only 10%
Execution → win journal: repeat. Loss journal: avoid. Miss journal: catch next time
Don't change your decision again and again — even if it means only 4 trades in a month.
Do rule-based trading.
Trade like a robot, exit the trade safely, and don't get too greedy.
Don't decide in advance to be a buyer or a seller. You are a trader: trade wherever you find an opportunity.
Don't be biased towards one direction in advance.
No regret for missed trades.
Be the hunter, not the hunted.
The market punishes emotions.
Small mistakes create big losses — be disciplined!
Follow the plan → protect your capital.
